title: Storey Architecture header
description: A fixed, bare header: a plain grotesk wordmark at the left and three small links at the page's halfway line, drawn in white with a difference blend so they turn black over white sections and stay white over photos and black bands; a solid black Contact button with a dashed ring at the right. On phones: wordmark and a large 'Menu' word that opens a full-screen black menu.
notes: fixed: it overlays the page; the wordmark and links invert against whatever is under them (mix-blend-mode: difference with white ink), so they work on any theme
the Contact button is not blended: it is bg-primary, and on a band of the same colour it disappears, as on the original
the phone menu needs JavaScript (hydrate: load)
name: storeyarchitecture-header
